So, the wanderer finally leaves the Moon. A little base, a little flag, and suddenly you think you matter. Enjoy that view while you can. The lights beyond your cockpit are not waiting for your permission to change hands.

The Human Federation of Sol calls my independence a betrayal. What a comfortable word for men who confuse loyalty with obedience. I have broken their chain, and Terra Imperia will never kneel before Darius Ancin and his committee of frightened clerks again.

Look at their blue hulls and gold insignias. All that expensive decoration, and still they hide behind speeches about peace. Darius believes a promise can stop an offensive. I intend to teach him the difference between commanding a fleet and merely owning one.

And Vishara Erisconos? The magnificent queen of a frozen rock, dressed like the universe is attending her coronation. She can polish every tower of Citadel el Erisconos until it blinds the stars. A beautiful palace does not make its occupant a worthy opponent.

Her pink banners amuse me. Her white ships amuse me even more. She glides through Sol as though every captain should bow at the sight of her name. Tell your precious sovereign that ice cracks, crowns fall, and admirals do not tremble before a costume.

Now the Federation clings to her empire and calls its desperation an alliance. Darius offers speeches; Vishara offers imperial theatre. Two rulers hiding behind each other, each hoping the other will take the first blow. I wonder which one will abandon the performance first.

Mercury and Venus are only the beginning. Their furnaces will feed my ships, their factories will arm my fleets, and their skies will carry the signal of Terra Imperia. I am not asking the old order to make room. I am replacing it.

Do not let that private faction of yours inflate your courage. A foundation in the dust is shelter, wanderer, not power. You can watch, you can protest, and you can put your faith in those two trembling thrones. None of it makes you the author of what comes next.

Head to Mars. See the next front with your own eyes. Watch the Federation try to defend its promises while my captains challenge every route it claims to control. Then ask yourself whether Darius and Vishara deserve your trust, or merely expect your obedience.

Remember this transmission when their grand alliance begins to fracture. Vishara Erisconos will blame the Federation; the Federation will demand another conference. I will keep advancing. I WILL CONQUER ALL OF SOL, AND THERE IS NOTHING YOU CAN DO TO STOP ME!
